additional_info.subject: Reported from the customer
additional_info.body:
We need assistance with the CCV terminal on this charger.
The charger reports a error in the log:
We have been in contact with CCV to see if there are any issues from there end. They report that all looks good at there end, and the terminal should be working.
They had this comment:
"
My colleagues and I checked the settings and the commands, and we can´t find the commands for the registration from charger and payment terminal (command 0600).
Please check the login commands from cash register to terminal.
"
The charger have been updated to latest FW 6.0.3, that did not change anything.
We have done the configuration via SiCharge D companion tool.
With the help from CCV we have also tried to use CCV´s software, with no effect.
The entire log from the terminal have been extracted and sent to CCV for analysis, they did not find any issues from there end. (The mail between us and CCV you can find here
WG Test CCV.msg
)
I do not know what to do now, please advice..

additional_info.subject: RE: 0401763 - ID0401763-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R5 170001905] CCV "out of order" issue CRM:00314000138
additional_info.body:
Good morning Rasmus,
I am really to sorry to hear that. I apologize for the delay in providing you with support and a solution.
Unfortunately, at the moment the “PaymentTerminalOutOfOrder” error for CCV is not currently identified as critical, and replacement is not indicated as the solution. Therefore, our goal was to find the root cause of the terminal being “out of order”, and restore its operational status. Clearly, we weren't able to provide this support in a timely manner, and it is completely understandable that the customer decided to replace the terminal.
From our side, we will proceed anyway with the investigation, to understand the root cause and determine a solution path for future service cases.
Once again, I apologize for the inconvenience. I will redirect you to the NOC Team support in order to handle the warranty case for the replacement.
